$comment: Generated from annotation/types.go by cmd/schema; do not edit. This file is for tools (validators, editor autocomplete). For humans: read annotation/types.go or SPEC.md.

name.description: Short name, e.g. "A", "B", "2". Referenced by Field.Copies and Mask.Copies.

pages.description: 0-based PDF page indexes, in order. Field.Page indexes into this list.

Copy.description: Copy is one copy of the form (e.g.

id.description: Unique within the annotation (within its group, for a group's fields).

label.description: The box label as printed, e.g. "1 Wages, tips, other compensation".

page.description: Index into the copy's Pages list. Defaults to 0.

copies.description:
Restrict this field to these copies (e.g. VOID only exists on A and D).
Empty means every copy.

rect.description:
Where the value is printed, for the first slot and first group row.
Required, except on a field with a group.

source.description:
JSONPath to the value. Exactly one of Source or Template is required
(checkboxes require Source).

template.description:
Text with embedded paths, e.g. "{@.city}, {@.state} {@.zip}". Lines
whose placeholders are all empty are dropped. Output is plain text.

checkedValue.description:
Checkbox only: the value that checks the box. When omitted the box is
checked by boolean true. Use it for radio-like groups, e.g. filing
status "single" / "mfj", one checkbox field per option.

cells.description: Comb only: number of character cells.

format.description: How the value is converted to text. Defaults to text.

style.description: Typography; unset keys take the built-in defaults (see Style).

overflow.description:
What to do when the text does not fit: "shrink" (default) makes the
font smaller down to minSize, then cuts the text and warns; "error"
prints nothing and reports an error.

required.description: Report an error when the value is missing or null.

meta.description: Free-form extension data (e.g. e-file XPath, extraction hints).

group.description:
Repeating rows. When set, this field is a group: it takes only id,
label, page, copies and group, and prints its inner fields once per row.

Field.description: Field is one box on the form.

title.description: Human-readable title as printed on the form.

jurisdiction.description: Issuing authority: "US" for federal, "US-CA" for California, etc.

taxYear.description: Tax year the form is used for.

revision.description: Revision as printed on the form, e.g. "2026" or "Rev. December 2025".

pdf.description: The blank PDF this annotation was authored against.

decimals.description:
currency, number: digits after the decimal point. Rounding is half away
from zero on the exact decimal value (never binary floating point).
Defaults to 2 for currency and 0 for number.

zero.description: currency, number: "show" (default) prints zero; "blank" prints nothing.

part.description:
currency, number: print only one part of the rounded amount, for forms
with separate dollars and cents boxes. "integer" prints 1,234 (with
sign), "fraction" prints the decimal digits only (50). Default: both.

mask.description: ssn, ein: replace leading digits, e.g. XXX-XX-6789 on employee copies.

pattern.description: date: output pattern using YYYY, YY, MM, DD. Defaults to "MM/DD/YYYY".

Format.description: Format converts a data value to the printed string.

items.description:
JSONPath to the list whose items fill the rows, one item per row. If it
selects a single array, the array's elements are the items. Filters
work: "@.codes[?@.code != 'DD']". Inside the group "@" is the item.

rows.description:
One offset per printed row, applied to every inner field's rectangle.
More items than rows is reported as an error and only the first
len(rows) items are printed.

fields.description:
The fields of one row, with rectangles for the first row. They inherit
page and copies from the group's field. Groups cannot be nested.

Group.description: Group repeats a set of fields once per item of a list: W-2 box 12 (four code/amount rows), the two state rows, or a dependents table.

pageSize.description: Size of every page in points

copies.description:
Copies of the form contained in the PDF (W-2 has A, 1, B, C, 2, D).
A single-copy form has one entry.

slots.description:
Positions of form instances on one sheet. The W-2 prints two instances
per page (top and bottom), so it has two slots. Field rectangles are
authored for the first slot and shifted by each slot's offset.
Defaults to a single slot at offset (0, 0).

Layout.description: Layout describes the physical structure of the form.

visible.description: Number of trailing digits left visible (IRS truncation keeps 4).

copies.description:
Apply only on these copies (e.g. employee copies B, C, 2). Empty means
every copy.

Mask.description: Mask truncates an identifier, keeping only the last Visible digits.

Offset.description: Offset is a translation in points.

sha256.description:
Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the blank PDF. Renderers must refuse to render
onto a file with a different hash.

pageCount.description: Number of pages in the blank PDF.

Rect.description: Rect is a box in points, measured from the bottom-left of the page.

Size.description: Size is a width and height in points.

size.description: Font size in points. Defaults to 10.

minSize.description: Smallest size "shrink" may use. Defaults to 6 (or Size, if smaller).

align.description:
"left", "center" or "right". Defaults to right for currency and number,
left otherwise.

valign.description: "top" or "middle". Defaults to top for multiline, middle otherwise.

padding.description: Inner spacing on every side, in points. Defaults to 2.

Style.description: Style controls size and placement inside the rectangle.

specVersion.description: Version of the TFA format this file is written against (semver).

annotationVersion.description:
Revision of this annotation file. Published files are immutable: any
correction produces a new file with annotationVersion + 1.

form.description: The exact blank form this annotation describes.

instances.description:
JSONPath selecting the form instances to render: one form is printed
per match (e.g. one W-2 per employer), and "@" in field paths refers to
that match. Omit for forms printed once per return; "@" is then the
data root.

layout.description: Page geometry, copies, and instance slots.

fields.description:
Every box on the form, in reading order. Repeating rows (W-2 box 12,
state rows 15-20) are fields with a group.

title: Tax Form Annotation 1.0.0
description: Annotation describes one revision of one form.
